get.summary: List all available tools with metadata
List one-time credit packs and monthly subscription plans
get.description: Public, no auth. One-time packs: Starter Pack (3,000 credits, $9), Pro Pack (25,000 credits, $49), Business Pack (125,000 credits, $199). Each pack's `id` is the exact value POST /v1/billing/checkout accepts as `pack`; each subscription's `id` is what POST /v1/billing/subscribe accepts as `plan`.

post.summary: Create a Stripe Checkout session for a one-time credit pack
post.description: Requires an API key or signed-in session. Packs: starter = Starter Pack (3,000 credits, $9), pro = Pro Pack (25,000 credits, $49), business = Business Pack (125,000 credits, $199). Legacy ids small/medium/large are accepted as aliases for starter/pro/business.

pack.description: Credit pack id (the `id` from GET /v1/billing/plans). Legacy aliases small/medium/large map to starter/pro/business. The key `plan` is also accepted as an alias for `pack`.

url.description: Stripe Checkout URL — open it to complete payment

400.description: Unknown pack id, or a subscription plan id was sent (use POST /v1/billing/subscribe for subscriptions)

post.summary: Create a Stripe Checkout session for a monthly subscription plan
post.description: Requires an API key or signed-in session. Plans: starter-monthly (10,000 credits/mo, $19), pro-monthly (30,000 credits/mo, $49), growth-monthly (75,000 credits/mo, $99), business-monthly (175,000 credits/mo, $199).

plan.description: Subscription plan id (the `id` from GET /v1/billing/plans). Bare tier names sent as `plan` (starter, pro, growth, business) expand to the -monthly plan id.

url.description: Stripe Checkout URL — open it to complete payment

400.description: Unknown plan id, or a one-time pack id was sent via `pack` (use POST /v1/billing/checkout for one-time packs)
